cn.releaseNotes:
• Compatibility with iOS 27 and iPadOS 27
• Improvements to issue reporting
• Wipr Extra improvements on many websites
cn.description:
Wipr blocks ads, popups, trackers, cookie warnings, and other nasty things that make the web slow and ugly.

Websites in Safari will look clean, load fast, and stop invisibly tracking you. You’ll notice significant improvements to your battery life and data usage. Setup is a snap.

The Filtr add-on extends Wipr’s blocking to all apps on your devices. It acts at the network level, but unlike a VPN, it can access none of your data, and can be used in conjunction with VPNs, iCloud Private Relay, and custom DNS.

Wipr’s blocklist is updated twice a week automatically, and has enhanced versions for the following languages: Bosnian, Chinese, Croatian, Czech, Danish, Dutch, Estonian, Finnish, French, German, Greek, Hebrew, Hindi, Hungarian, Icelandic, Indonesian, Italian, Japanese, Korean, Macedonian, Malay, Montenegrin, Norwegian, Polish, Romanian, Russian, Serbian, Slovak, Spanish, Thai, and Vietnamese.

Wipr is a universal app: install it on all your devices (iPhone, iPad, Mac, Vision Pro) with a single purchase. It’s fully accessible with VoiceOver, Voice Control, and more. Dark, Tinted, and Clear icon variants are included. Family Sharing is supported.

Because it’s developed by a single independent developer and 100% funded by its users, Wipr only answers to you: no one can pay to have their ads unblocked, and there are no “acceptable ads”.

This app was made with love and patience. I hope you’ll enjoy using it as much as I enjoyed designing and building it.

– Kaylee

hk.description:
加入数百万玩家，开启这款怪物训练游戏的续集冒险之旅！
在《EvoCreo 2》中，进入充满神秘的怪物世界，捕捉、培养并进化超过300种怪物。体验一个开放世界的RPG，展开一场充满怪物战斗与冒险的游戏旅程。怪物的进化和捕捉是你在这个怪物游戏中的使命，而这片土地上神秘的怪物，等待着你的探索！

揭开迷人的冒险故事
作为一名新兵，在《EvoCreo 2》的角色扮演游戏（RPG）中，加入Shoru警察学院，解开怪物消失背后的谜团。这个怪物游戏不仅仅是捕捉怪物，背后还有更深的阴谋，考验你在怪物战斗中的策略能力。途中，你将完成50多个引人入胜的任务，帮助Shoru的市民，建立联盟并发现隐藏的宝藏。

捕捉与培养超过300只怪物
你喜欢怪物收集游戏吗？在这个开放世界RPG中，组建你的梦想队伍，捕捉、培养、进化各种怪物。游戏中包含了超过300种独特的怪物，每个怪物都有其独特的进化和颜色。体验多样化的怪物捕捉与培养，让你在回合制怪物战斗中制定策略，挑战自我，成为传奇怪物训练师！

探索充满怪物的冒险世界
在《EvoCreo 2》里，你可以享受超过30小时的离线与在线RPG玩法，探索这个充满怪物和隐藏秘密的开放世界。从茂密的森林到神秘的洞穴，再到繁华的城镇，Shoru大陆充满了待解的谜题。在冒险的过程中，挑战不同的怪物，完成任务，解锁隐藏的路径和传奇的宝藏。

掌握深度且策略性的战斗系统
准备好迎接训练师之间的激烈战斗了吗？在这个高度可定制化的RPG游戏中，你可以装备你的怪物，并解锁100多种独特特征来增强它们的能力。训练你的怪物，学习并掌握超过200种技能，随时根据战斗的需要调整技能。通过怪物战斗，管理元素弱点，运用策略技能，成为真正的怪物训练大师！

证明自己，成为终极怪物训练大师
挑战Shoru的最强怪物训练师，在这个付费RPG游戏中崭露头角！参加声名显赫的竞技场，只有最强的怪物训练师才能获得冠军称号。你能在怪物战斗中获得胜利，登上冠军宝座，成为最顶尖的怪物训练大师吗？

主要特点：
- 世界顶级付费角色扮演游戏的续集
- 捕捉、培养、进化超过300只怪物
- 没有怪物等级上限，充满挑战的游戏结局！
- 拓展的开放世界，30小时以上的离线与在线RPG玩法
- 引人入胜的回合制怪物战斗，深度策略元素
- 数百种技能和特征，自由定制你的怪物
- 超过50个充满冒险和奖励的任务
- 离线模式——无需互联网也能畅玩游戏
- 精美的像素艺术，回归经典怪物RPG风格

玩家为何喜爱《EvoCreo 2》：
《EvoCreo 2》是怪物训练游戏和怪物培养RPG的完美结合
物种收集、探索和战斗策略的完美融合
休闲和硬核玩家都能享受这款充满冒险和动作的怪物游戏
今天就加入我们的冒险，开始成为终极怪物训练大师的旅程吧！你能捕捉所有怪物，解开Creo的秘密吗？

hk.description:
承諾在每一個系統中展現 Sabotage 的獨特風格，《星之海》致力於為回合制戰鬥、敘事、探索與環境互動等層面注入現代化設計，同時保留經典 RPG 那份美好的懷舊氛圍與純粹的遊戲樂趣。

故事講述兩位至日之子，他們集日月之力施展星蝕魔法，這是唯一能對抗邪惡鍊金術士「血肉法師」及其可怕造物的力量。

透過打破傳統網格限制的導航系統，玩家能無縫穿梭於世界各地，並在沉浸感十足的體驗中迎戰敵人；遊戲中沒有隨機遇敵、無須切換至獨立戰場，也不需要反覆農怪。

特色
- 引人入勝的回合制戰鬥：結合看準時機的打擊、連攜攻擊、強化機制，以及具策略性的「弱點鎖定」系統，帶來沉浸式的戰鬥體驗；同樣沒有隨機遇敵、沒有戰場切換，也不強迫玩家農怪。
- 全面動態光影效果：我們自製的渲染管線突破了 2D 像素美術遊戲的極限，打造出栩栩如生、令人屏息的世界。
- 劇情豐富的冒險旅程：有時史詩壯闊、有時詼諧幽默，有時又賺人熱淚，《星之海》在探索冒險與友情等經典 RPG 主題的同時，也充滿了 Sabotage 作品一貫的意外轉折與驚喜事件。
- 一個能親手體驗的世界：航海、料理、釣魚、到酒館聽首歌，或遊玩那款惡名昭彰的桌上遊戲「輪盤」……每一個系統都經過精心設計，在致敬復古經典的同時也重新構思，帶來流暢且現代化的遊戲體驗。

專為行動裝置精心打造

- 全新操作介面：支援完整觸控的專屬手機 UI
- Game Center 成就系統
- 雲端存檔：支援 iOS 裝置間進度同步
- 相容 MFi 控制器
- 針對 iPhone 16（含 Pro Max）全面優化

重要公告：
由於記憶體容量有限，下列裝置在執行本遊戲時可能無法提供穩定的體驗，遊戲流暢度也可能受到影響：
iPhone Xr、iPhone SE（第二代，2020 年）、iPad Mini（第五代）、iPad Air（第三代）、iPad（第八代與第九代）
為了獲得最佳的遊戲體驗，我們不建議在上述機型上遊玩本遊戲。

hk.description:
Access Code Zero tells the story of a spy operation at the Quarantine Bay complex, captured by a group of separatists called HOMOGENES. The main character of the game Bijou, must infiltrate the Quarantine Bay, find researches data, and get back safely.

Access Code Zero - an exploration-focused retro-styled platformer in METROIDVANIA genre. The game is expected to follow Metroidvania-style gameplay. 

* MFI controllers support

hk.releaseNotes:
感謝大家對 Digline 的喜愛！本版本新增：

-Digline 現已完整支援丹麥語！
-錯誤修正與優化
hk.description:
《Digline》是一款輕鬆上手的鑽探遊戲。每一次向地下深入，都是一場在進度與風險之間的抉擇，而真正的獎勵，總藏在更深的地底。

每次探險都從你的工坊開始。選擇裝備，駕駛燃料有限、設備簡陋的鑽探機出發。開鑿屬於自己的路線，穿越不斷變化的地層，決定要收集哪些資源，並在燃料耗盡前，思考該升級什麼、交易什麼。

每一次下潛，都可能發現新的材料、更稀有的礦物，以及地底深處意想不到的規律。原本只是單純的挖掘，逐漸演變成探索、效率與時機掌握之間的巧妙平衡。

回到地面後，持續優化你的策略，讓每一次探險都更有效率：

• 升級鑽頭、燃料容量與鑽探效率
• 解鎖價值更高、埋藏更深的新材料
• 規劃最佳路線，讓每一次下潛都收穫滿滿

你的進度會穩定累積，但每一次探險都充滿張力。太過保守，就會錯失珍貴資源；冒險太深，則可能失去一切。

打造屬於自己的探勘節奏：快速有效率的短程挖掘、高風險高報酬的深層探險，或穩紮穩打，逐步征服地底世界。

曾登上美國、英國休閒遊戲排行榜前 10 名，以及德國、挪威等多國前 5 名。現在就加入這場挖掘冒險吧！

原本只是尋找資源的旅程，卻漸漸變得更加神秘。你挖出的隧道會永久保留，地圖會隨著探索不斷擴展，而地下世界也開始不像隨機生成，更像是一個擁有自己歷史的地方。

《Digline》設計理念就是容易上手、適合利用零碎時間遊玩，同時又能帶來長期的成就感。快速開挖、短程探險，享受源源不絕的輕鬆樂趣。

特色：

• 直覺式單指直向操作
• 每次探險只需一、兩分鐘，隨時都能遊玩
• 永久保留的地下隧道，以及持續擴展的地圖
• 多個地下區域，各自擁有不同的資源、危險與驚喜
• 收集資源，用於製作升級與更完善的探險準備
• 工坊系統，讓每一次成功探險都化為永久成長
• 市場交易系統，出售帶回來的資源
• 跨越多次遊戲持續累積的成長，而非單次探險
• 寧靜舒適的氛圍，搭配充滿探索感的地下世界
• 無廣告，無內購，沒有任何付費才能獲勝的機制
• 成就系統與「每日挖掘」排行榜競賽

挖得越深，礦坑揭露的秘密就越多。

mo.releaseNotes:
世界持續變化！而 Plague Inc. (瘟疫公司) 也隨之進化！

去年，我們為 Plague Inc. (瘟疫公司) 的世界新增了十億人口，現在又帶來更多人口供你感染。

2026 世界更新採用世界銀行最新的全球資料集，升級 Plague Inc. (瘟疫公司) 的核心模擬模型。
mo.description:
《瘟疫公司》是一個非常真實的策略模擬類游戲。 
您的病原體剛剛感染了“零號病人”。現在您必須適應這個世界，不停改進病原體的傳染力和抵抗力，以便應對人類的反擊措施，最終進化成一個全球性的恐怖瘟疫。
這是為iPhone和iPad設計的全新遊戲，保證將游戲（和您）的標準一同推向更高境界。這是您和全世界的競爭- 唯有強者才能生存！

◈◈◈全球頂尖的手機遊戲◈◈◈ 

《瘟疫公司》是一款極受全球玩家歡迎的策略型遊戲。遊戲獲得近百萬個五星級評價，同時被多家媒體爭相報導，包括經濟學人、紐約每日新聞、衛報、倫敦地鐵和波士頓先驅報等等！
《瘟疫公司》的創辦人更曾獲美國疾病控制預防中心邀請出席在亞特蘭大舉辦的座談會，來分享遊戲內的疾病模型！
 “《瘟疫公司》使用一條非傳統路線來提高公眾對流行病學、疾病傳播和流行疾病信息的意識。”- 美國疾病控制與預防中心
▶ “2012年最佳平板遊戲”- 紐約每日新聞
▶“《瘟疫公司》會在所有方面吸引並保持您的注意力。”- Touch Arcade
▶“《瘟疫公司》的確是一個高質量的遊戲。”- Modojo
▶“《瘟疫公司》真的非常精彩！” London Metro
▶“毀滅全世界的同時又不乏趣味性。”- Pocket Lint
▶“《瘟疫公司》太讓人上癮了！” - Slide to Play
▶ 2012年年度“最佳策略遊戲獎”- Pocket Gamer
▶“殺死幾十億人從未如此有趣過。”- IGN

◈◈◈ 

遊戲特點：
● 出色的Retina顯示與高質量的界面相結合
● 使用超強人工智能技術設計，以更細緻、更真實地模擬現實世界。
● 完整的遊戲功能說明與幫助內容
● 12種病原體，毀滅世界的策略各有不同！ 
● 完整的保存/載入遊戲功能 
● 超過50個國家，上百種性狀和上千種世界事件等您去發掘。
● 完全支持成就係統和排行榜。 
● 更新版本新增了能夠精神上控制人類的Neurax蠕蟲、能夠製造殭屍的Necroa病毒、急速通關模式和多種劇情模式！
● 工作室目前已依次增加了對簡體中文、英語、德語、西班牙語、葡萄牙語、意大利語、法語、日語、韓語和俄語的支持。 （我們還會陸續增加更多語言！）
● 您能拯救世界嗎？現誠邀您在《瘟疫公司》迄今最大規模更新擴展中執掌大權並遏止全球致命流行病！
● 挑戰每日疾病，贏得強效升級，並在疫情模式中與全世界一較高下！

 為了慶祝Plague Inc. (瘟疫公司) 獲得2015年最受歡迎付費應用第五名特別舉辦特價優惠活動！ 

請在Plague Inc. (瘟疫公司) 的Facebook上贊好！
http://www.facebook.com/PlagueInc 
歡迎您關注我們的Twitter

www.twitter.com/NdemicCreations

tw.description:
加入数百万玩家，开启这款怪物训练游戏的续集冒险之旅！
在《EvoCreo 2》中，进入充满神秘的怪物世界，捕捉、培养并进化超过300种怪物。体验一个开放世界的RPG，展开一场充满怪物战斗与冒险的游戏旅程。怪物的进化和捕捉是你在这个怪物游戏中的使命，而这片土地上神秘的怪物，等待着你的探索！

揭开迷人的冒险故事
作为一名新兵，在《EvoCreo 2》的角色扮演游戏（RPG）中，加入Shoru警察学院，解开怪物消失背后的谜团。这个怪物游戏不仅仅是捕捉怪物，背后还有更深的阴谋，考验你在怪物战斗中的策略能力。途中，你将完成50多个引人入胜的任务，帮助Shoru的市民，建立联盟并发现隐藏的宝藏。

捕捉与培养超过300只怪物
你喜欢怪物收集游戏吗？在这个开放世界RPG中，组建你的梦想队伍，捕捉、培养、进化各种怪物。游戏中包含了超过300种独特的怪物，每个怪物都有其独特的进化和颜色。体验多样化的怪物捕捉与培养，让你在回合制怪物战斗中制定策略，挑战自我，成为传奇怪物训练师！

探索充满怪物的冒险世界
在《EvoCreo 2》里，你可以享受超过30小时的离线与在线RPG玩法，探索这个充满怪物和隐藏秘密的开放世界。从茂密的森林到神秘的洞穴，再到繁华的城镇，Shoru大陆充满了待解的谜题。在冒险的过程中，挑战不同的怪物，完成任务，解锁隐藏的路径和传奇的宝藏。

掌握深度且策略性的战斗系统
准备好迎接训练师之间的激烈战斗了吗？在这个高度可定制化的RPG游戏中，你可以装备你的怪物，并解锁100多种独特特征来增强它们的能力。训练你的怪物，学习并掌握超过200种技能，随时根据战斗的需要调整技能。通过怪物战斗，管理元素弱点，运用策略技能，成为真正的怪物训练大师！

证明自己，成为终极怪物训练大师
挑战Shoru的最强怪物训练师，在这个付费RPG游戏中崭露头角！参加声名显赫的竞技场，只有最强的怪物训练师才能获得冠军称号。你能在怪物战斗中获得胜利，登上冠军宝座，成为最顶尖的怪物训练大师吗？

主要特点：
- 世界顶级付费角色扮演游戏的续集
- 捕捉、培养、进化超过300只怪物
- 没有怪物等级上限，充满挑战的游戏结局！
- 拓展的开放世界，30小时以上的离线与在线RPG玩法
- 引人入胜的回合制怪物战斗，深度策略元素
- 数百种技能和特征，自由定制你的怪物
- 超过50个充满冒险和奖励的任务
- 离线模式——无需互联网也能畅玩游戏
- 精美的像素艺术，回归经典怪物RPG风格

玩家为何喜爱《EvoCreo 2》：
《EvoCreo 2》是怪物训练游戏和怪物培养RPG的完美结合
物种收集、探索和战斗策略的完美融合
休闲和硬核玩家都能享受这款充满冒险和动作的怪物游戏
今天就加入我们的冒险，开始成为终极怪物训练大师的旅程吧！你能捕捉所有怪物，解开Creo的秘密吗？

tw.description:
承諾在每一個系統中展現 Sabotage 的獨特風格，《星之海》致力於為回合制戰鬥、敘事、探索與環境互動等層面注入現代化設計，同時保留經典 RPG 那份美好的懷舊氛圍與純粹的遊戲樂趣。

故事講述兩位至日之子，他們集日月之力施展星蝕魔法，這是唯一能對抗邪惡鍊金術士「血肉法師」及其可怕造物的力量。

透過打破傳統網格限制的導航系統，玩家能無縫穿梭於世界各地，並在沉浸感十足的體驗中迎戰敵人；遊戲中沒有隨機遇敵、無須切換至獨立戰場，也不需要反覆農怪。

特色
- 引人入勝的回合制戰鬥：結合看準時機的打擊、連攜攻擊、強化機制，以及具策略性的「弱點鎖定」系統，帶來沉浸式的戰鬥體驗；同樣沒有隨機遇敵、沒有戰場切換，也不強迫玩家農怪。
- 全面動態光影效果：我們自製的渲染管線突破了 2D 像素美術遊戲的極限，打造出栩栩如生、令人屏息的世界。
- 劇情豐富的冒險旅程：有時史詩壯闊、有時詼諧幽默，有時又賺人熱淚，《星之海》在探索冒險與友情等經典 RPG 主題的同時，也充滿了 Sabotage 作品一貫的意外轉折與驚喜事件。
- 一個能親手體驗的世界：航海、料理、釣魚、到酒館聽首歌，或遊玩那款惡名昭彰的桌上遊戲「輪盤」……每一個系統都經過精心設計，在致敬復古經典的同時也重新構思，帶來流暢且現代化的遊戲體驗。

專為行動裝置精心打造

- 全新操作介面：支援完整觸控的專屬手機 UI
- Game Center 成就系統
- 雲端存檔：支援 iOS 裝置間進度同步
- 相容 MFi 控制器
- 針對 iPhone 16（含 Pro Max）全面優化

重要公告：
由於記憶體容量有限，下列裝置在執行本遊戲時可能無法提供穩定的體驗，遊戲流暢度也可能受到影響：
iPhone Xr、iPhone SE（第二代，2020 年）、iPad Mini（第五代）、iPad Air（第三代）、iPad（第八代與第九代）
為了獲得最佳的遊戲體驗，我們不建議在上述機型上遊玩本遊戲。

- New cinematic intro

Thanks for playing!
us.description:
Promising the Sabotage touch in every system, Sea of Stars aims to modernize the classic RPG formula in terms of turn-based combat, storytelling, exploration and interactions with the environment, while still offering a hearty slice of nostalgia and good old, simple fun.

It tells the story of two Children of the Solstice who will combine the powers of the sun and moon to perform Eclipse Magic, the only force capable of fending off the monstrous creations of the evil alchemist known as The Fleshmancer.

Traverse seamlessly through the world with a navigation system that breaks free from the classic bound-to-the-grid tileset movement and fight enemies in an immersive take on the genre; no random encounters, no transitions to separate battlefields, and no grinding.

FEATURES
- Engaging turn-based combat: Along with timed hits, combat features combo attacks, boosting, and a strategic "locks" system, all in an immersive take on the genre; no random encounters, no transitions to separate battlefields, and no grinding.
- Full-on dynamic lighting: Our custom-made render pipeline allows the creation of a breathtaking world coming to life by pushing the limits of 2D pixel-art games.
- A story-rich adventure: Sometimes epic, sometimes silly, and other times emotional, Sea of Stars does its RPG duty of exploring classic themes of adventure and friendship, while also being chock-full of the unexpected twists and events you’d expect from a Sabotage production.
- A world you can touch: Sailing, cooking, fishing, stopping by a tavern to listen to a song or play the infamous tabletop game known as "Wheels"... every system has been designed to deliver an experience that pays respect to retro classics, while rethinking in some areas to offer a smooth and modernized experience.

CAREFULLY REDESIGNED FOR MOBILE
- Revamped interface – exclusive mobile UI with complete touch control
- Game Center achievements
- Cloud Save – Share your progress between iOS devices
- Compatible with MFi controllers
- iPhone 16 Optimization (including Pro Max)

Important notice:
Due to limited RAM, the following devices may not provide a stable experience and the game may not run as smoothly as intended:
"iPhone Xr, iPhone SE (2nd Gen, 2020)
iPad Mini (5th Gen), iPad Air (3rd Gen), iPad (8th & 9th Gen)"
For the best experience, we do not recommend playing on these models.

us.description:
The best interactive app for learning musculoskeletal anatomy. 

AnatomyMapp® combines an empowering collection of study tools for the popular Trail Guide to the Body—a best-selling musculoskeletal anatomy textbook—into a single interactive app! It's great for not only reinforcing your textbook learning but also for studying while on the bus, having a snack, or pretty much wherever you have your phone.
 
AnatomyMapp® includes information from all 362 Trail Guide to the Body Flashcards; questions from the Trail Guide to the Body Student Workbook; and easy search and bookmarking capabilities:

• Test your musculoskeletal anatomy knowledge by (1) answering multiple choice question (muscle cards only); (2) locating specific structures; or (3) identifying actions, origins, insertions, and nerve innervations (AOIN).

• Bookmark specific cards to review later and use enhanced navigation features for bookmarked cards.

• Apply the easy search function to choose all cards or only cards you’ve bookmarked.

• Find additional information in the Trail Guide to the Body textbook with page references on each card.

• Zoom into cards to enhance your view of the illustrations.

• Learn correct pronunciation using the app’s audio pronunciation.
 
• Designed to be viewed in both landscape and portrait on iPad, and portrait mode on iPhone.

If you have any comments or suggestions, we’d like to hear from you at info@booksofdiscovery.com.
 
More than 2,000 manual therapy programs have chosen Trail Guide to the Body products for their students. The textbook is sold in nearly 40 countries.
 
AnatomyMapp® is a registered trademark of Books of Discovery. Learn more at booksofdiscovery.com.

Enter the Aperture Science Enrichment Center and experience Bridge Constructor Portal – the unique merging of the classic Portal™ and Bridge Constructor™ games.

As a new employee in the Aperture Science test lab, it's your job to build bridges, ramps, slides, and other constructions in 60 test chambers and get the Bendies safely across the finish line in their vehicles.
Make use of the many Portal gadgets, like portals, propulsion gel, repulsion gel, aerial faith plates, cubes, and more to bypass the sentry turrets, acid pools and laser barriers, solve switch puzzles, and make it through the test chambers unscathed.

Let Ellen McLain, the original voice of GLaDOS, guide you through the tutorial, and learn all the tips and tricks that make a true Aperture Science employee.

The bridge is a lie!

Features:
-    The merging of two worlds: the first Bridge Constructor™ with an official Portal™ license
-    Create complex constructions in the Aperture Science labs
-    Let GLaDOS accompany you through tricky physics adventures
-    Use portals, aerial faith plates, propulsion gel, repulsion gel, and much more to master the complicated tasks
-    Evade dangers such as sentry turrets, emancipation grills, laser fields, and acid
-    Help your Bendies cross the finish line – on their own or in a convoy


PORTAL PROFICIENCY DLC

Bridge Constructor Portal receives a fresh DLC as hot as a potato: Portal Proficiency
Return to the Aperture Science Enrichment Center and experience a brand-new challenge.
Finally, you are now able to not only construct bridges, but you can even place portals yourself!
It’s just like the real thing!
 
Face up to 30 brain-teasing, remarkably unsafe test chambers in three chapters.
Create insane constructions and decide where to place portals to show if you really are proficient in working with Portals.
Only the bravest and smartest participants will succeed and receive the Golden Condolence Letter.
 
Features
•	New Aperture Science test series with 30 brand new, brain-teasing levels
•	New feature: place the portals in the new test chambers yourself!

tr.description:
Join millions of players in this pocket monster game sequel
Embark on an epic adventure in EvoCreo 2, the ultimate monster-catching RPG set in the captivating world of Shoru. Immerse yourself in a land teeming with mythical creatures called Creo. For thousands of years, these collectible monsters have roamed the lands, their origins and evolution shrouded in mystery. Do you have what it takes to unravel the secrets of the Creo and become a legendary Evoking Master Trainer?

Uncover a Compelling Adventure Game
Begin your role playing game (RPG) journey as a new recruit in the Shoru Police Academy. Creo Monsters are disappearing, and it's your mission to uncover the truth behind these mysterious events. But there's more to the story than meets the eye in this monster game — dark plots are brewing, and your skills will be put to the test. Along the way, assist the citizens of Shoru by completing over 50 engaging missions, building alliances, and discovering hidden treasures.

Capture and Train Over 300 Monsters
Love monster-collecting games? Build your RPG dream team of Creo in this open-world role playing game. Hunt rare and legendary monsters, each available in unique alternate colors. With over 300 unique monsters to capture, evolve, and train, you’ll have endless possibilities to customize your strategy in pocket monster games. Create powerful combinations and lead your Creo to victory in thrilling turn-based battles.

Explore this monster adventure game
Experience more than 30 hours of offline and online rpg gameplay as you dive into a richly detailed open world. From dense forests to mysterious caves and bustling towns, the continent of Shoru is filled with secrets waiting to be uncovered. Adventure through diverse environments, complete challenging quests, and uncover hidden paths to legendary treasures. Explore 2 more biomes in this sequel like the desert and find many monsters on the way of your adventure. 

Master a deep and strategic RPG battle system as a monster trainer & hunter
Prepare for trainer battles with a highly customizable system. Equip your Creo with items and unlock over 100 unique traits to enhance their abilities. Train your Creo to learn and master over 200 moves, which you can swap anytime to adapt to new challenges. Face fierce opponents, manage elemental weaknesses, and use your tactical skills to gain the upper hand. Can you become a pocket monster master trainer?

Prove Yourself as the Ultimate Master Trainer
Challenge the strongest monster trainers across Shoru and rise through the ranks in this paid role playing game. Compete in the prestigious Coliseum, where only the best monster trainers are crowned as champions. Will you conquer every rpg battle and claim the title of Evoking Master Trainer?

Key Features:
- Sequel of one of the top paid role playing games worldwide
- 300+ collectible monsters to capture, train, and evolve.
- No level cap on your monsters - engaging endgame!
- A sprawling open world with 30+ hours of offline & online gameplay.
- Engaging turn-based battles with deep strategy elements.
- Hundreds of moves and traits to customize your Creo.
- Over 50 missions packed with adventure and rewards.
- Offline play—no internet required to enjoy the game.
- Stunning pixel art visuals reminiscent of classic monster RPGs.

Why Players Love EvoCreo 2:
Fans of Monster games and monster trainer RPGs will feel right at home.
A perfect mix of creature collection, exploration, and battle strategy.
Casual and hardcore gamers alike will enjoy the mix of action and adventure.

Join the adventure today and start your journey toward becoming the ultimate monster trainer in EvoCreo 2! Can you catch them all and master the secrets of the Creo?

pt.description:
Com a promessa da qualidade da Sabotage em cada sistema, Sea of Stars visa modernizar a fórmula clássica dos RPGs em termos de combate de turnos, narrativa, exploração e interação com o ambiente, oferecendo ainda um toque genuíno de nostalgia e da boa e velha diversão.

O jogo conta a história de duas Crianças do Solstício que combinarão seus poderes do sol e da lua para executar a Magia do Eclipse, a única força capaz de afugentar as criações monstruosas do alquimista maligno conhecido como Fleshmancer.

Percorra o mundo com um sistema de navegação que se liberta da movimentação clássica presa a um percurso e lute contra inimigos em uma versão imersiva do gênero; sem confrontos aleatórios, sem transições para campos de batalha separados e sem tarefas exaustivas.

RECURSOS
- Combate em turnos envolvente: além de golpes no tempo certo, os combates apresentam ataques combo, reforço e um sistema de "travas" estratégico.
- Iluminação dinâmica total: nosso pipeline de renderização personalizada permite a criação de um mundo estonteante que ganha a vida, forçando os limites dos jogos de arte em pixel 2D.
- Uma aventura com narrativa robusta: às vezes, épica, às vezes, bobinha, e outras vezes, emotiva. Sea of Stars cumpre seu dever como RPG de explorar temas clássicos de aventura e amizade, enquanto proporciona o assombro de eventos e reviravoltas inesperadas, tudo o que você esperaria de uma produção da Sabotage.
- Um mundo tangível: navegue, cozinhe, pesque, visite uma taverna para escutar uma canção ou curtir o famoso jogo de tabuleiro conhecido como "Rodas"... todo sistema foi desenvolvido para entregar uma experiência que presta homenagem a clássicos retrô, enquanto repensa algumas áreas a fim de oferecer uma experiência fluida e moderna.

REPROJETADO CUIDADOSAMENTE PARA DISPOSITIVOS MÓVEIS
- Interface remodelada: IU exclusiva para dispositivos móveis com controle de toque completo
- Gravação na nuvem: compartilhe seu progresso entre dispositivos iOS
- Compatível com controles MFi
- Otimização para iPhone 16 (incluindo Pro Max)- Conquistas do Game Center

Aviso importante:
Devido a uma limitação de RAM, os dispositivos a seguir podem fornecer uma experiência instável e não executar o jogo tão bem quanto esperado:
"iPhone Xr, iPhone SE (2ª geração, 2020)
iPad Mini (5ª geração), iPad Air (3ª geração), iPad (8ª e 9ª gerações)"
Para ter a melhor experiência de jogo, não recomendamos jogar nesses modelos.

pt.description:
Junta-te a milhões de jogadores na sequência do jogo de monstros Pocket Monster.
Embarca numa aventura épica em EvoCreo 2, o RPG de captura de monstros no mundo de Shoru. Descobre criaturas míticas chamadas Creo, que vagam pela terra com origens e evolução misteriosas. Tens o que é necessário para desvendar os segredos dos Creo e tornar-te um lendário Monster Hunter e Evoking Master Trainer?

Descobre um jogo de aventura envolvente
Inicia a tua jornada como recruta na Academia de Polícia de Shoru. Monstros Creo estão a desaparecer, e a tua missão é descobrir a verdade por trás destes eventos misteriosos. Mas há mais nesta história do que parece – intrigas sombrias estão a formar-se, e as tuas habilidades como Monster Hunter serão desafiadas. Ajuda os cidadãos de Shoru, completando mais de 50 missões, formando alianças e descobrindo tesouros escondidos.

Captura e treina mais de 300 monstros
Adoras jogos de Monster e captura de monstros? Cria a tua equipa de sonhos com Creo neste RPG de mundo aberto. Caça monstros raros e lendários, cada um disponível em cores alternativas exclusivas. Com mais de 300 monstros únicos para capturar, evoluir e treinar, terás várias possibilidades para personalizar a tua estratégia. Cria combinações poderosas e leva os teus Creo à vitória em emocionantes batalhas por turnos como um verdadeiro Monster Hunter.

Explora este jogo de aventura
Desfruta de mais de 30 horas de jogabilidade offline e online num mundo aberto ricamente detalhado. De florestas densas a cavernas misteriosas e cidades movimentadas, o continente de Shoru está cheio de segredos. Aventura-te por diferentes ambientes, completa missões desafiantes e descobre caminhos secretos para tesouros lendários. Explora 2 novos biomas nesta sequência de jogos de monstros, como a deslumbrante Wüste, e encontra muitos monstros na tua jornada.

Domina um sistema de combate profundo e estratégico
Prepara-te para batalhas de Monster Duel com um sistema personalizável. Equipa os teus monstros com itens e desbloqueia mais de 100 características únicas. Treina os teus monstros para aprender mais de 200 movimentos, que podes trocar a qualquer momento para te adaptaste aos novos desafios. Enfrenta oponentes ferozes, gere as fraquezas elementares e utiliza as tuas habilidades táticas em batalhas por turnos. Conseguirás tornar-te um mestre dos Pocket Monsters e capturá-los todos?

Prova-te como o/a Mestre Treinador/a definitivo/a
Desafia os treinadores mais fortes de Shoru e sobe nas classificações neste RPG pago. Luta no Coliseu, onde apenas os melhores Monster Hunter Trainers serão coroados campeões. Conquistarás todas as batalhas RPG e alcançarás o título de Evoking Master Trainer, tornando-te um dos melhores jogadores neste jogo de monstros?

Características principais:
- Continuação de um dos jogos pagos mais populares do mundo
- Mais de 300 monstros colecionáveis para capturar, treinar e evoluir
- Sem limite de nível para os seus monstros - final de jogo envolvente!
- Um vasto mundo aberto com mais de 30 horas de jogabilidade offline e online
- Batalhas por turnos emocionantes com elementos de estratégia de batalha profundos
- Centenas de movimentos e características para personalizar os teus Creo
- Mais de 50 missões cheias de aventura e recompensas
- Jogo offline – sem necessidade de internet para aproveitar o jogo
- Gráficos em pixel art, lembrando os clássicos RPGs de monstros

Por que os jogadores amam EvoCreo 2:
Fãs de jogos de Monstros vão se sentir em casa.

A mistura perfeita de coleção de monstros, exploração de mundo aberto e estratégia de batalha.
Jogadores casuais e hardcore vão adorar a combinação de ação e aventura neste RPG de monstros.

Junta-te à aventura hoje e começa a tua jornada para te tornares o mestre definitivo dos Monster Hunters em EvoCreo 2! Conseguirás capturá-los todos e dominar os segredos dos Creo? Um jogo fantástico de captura de monstros espera por ti!
